framework: Exact English full-time BA Philosophy specialisation PPS (56081; RIO1015O6460). Current adopted 2026–2027 annual OER, not concurrent prospective years or an old footer date, supplies one coherent ordinary examination framework. 180 EC = B1 compulsory60 + B2/B3 compulsory20 + thesis10 + four complete restricted modules60 + approved open electives30. First-listed semester-compatible distinct module choices are instantiated: Global Justice/Human Rights and Mental Health in autumn, Future of Democracy and Digital Revolution in spring; other modules remain alternatives. No module is counted twice. The 30 EC approved elective option is preserved as two open 15 EC blocks, not invented courses. RADAr English0 is mandatory. Passed Philosophical Writing Workshop precedes Project; passed Project precedes thesis. Seminar/practicum attendance is required. Project assessment is literature20/paper40/presentation20/group bundle20. Thesis5000–6000words; semester1 only for exchange/internship or prior adviser consent. Practice requires attendance, professional reflection and portfolio; presumed module knowledge is not converted into an extra passed-course prerequisite or allowed to erase the formal elective option. Current English and Dutch OER visibly both say BSA44EC, versus prospectus45; adopted rule controls. Specified delayed/later cases60EC. Modules must be complete except applicable transition provisions. The transition body explicitly states2026–2027 despite old2023–24 footers; expired-module exceptions are not used for a new entrant. Future offerings require annual checking.

comparability: Each retains five PHIL courses37.5EC, Political Philosophy7.5EC and AI Ethics7.5EC:52.5EC of direct philosophical inquiry, reinforced by mixed philosophical/legal rights and applied political/social inquiry. This establishes genuine substantive response to philosophical public questions, not degree equivalence. Shared18courses135EC include the philosophical core, modern-before-contemporary sociology, research methods, public problems and PPD. Primary adds45EC of law, international/EU institutions, rhetoric and stylistics; environmental route adds45EC of climate, film/environmental/race media, climate communication and documentary study. Only7.5ECclimate science is scientific context; media production/empirical research is not relabelled philosophy. No dedicated three-unit history, philosophy-of-science, full metaphysics or philosophical thesis is manufactured. Both make philosophy and application coherent; the secondary is distinct by45EC of actual sustained environmental/cultural communication work.

candidateStopping.assessment: Two substantively justified programmes retained, each with52.5ECdirect philosophical/political-philosophy/AI inquiry and a genuine applied structure. Six-course45ECdifference sustains the environmental/media alternative. Global justice/democracy remains covered by primary; mental-health and intercultural/gender candidate gaps remain explicit. Three is a maximum, not a target.
